hooks.name: Import audit after creating a Python file
hooks.description: Same check as the save hook, for new .py files the agent creates.

action.prompt: A new Python file was just created. Run `python scripts/audit_imports.py` now. If it reports a third-party import, a dynamic import, exec or eval, replace that code with standard-library code before doing anything else, then tell the owner what you changed. The own-code-only steering rules apply.
